nba jam countercade arcade w/3 games, 7\.name: NBA JAM Countercade Arcade w/3 Games, 7" LCD Screen & Light-Up Marquee
nba jam countercade arcade w/3 games, 7\.description: Boomshakalaka! Bring the roar of the crowd and the heat of the court directly to your tabletop with the Arcade1Up NBA JAM Countercade. This powerhouse machine packs the rim-rocking excitement of three legendary hoops classics into one portable frame: the original NBA JAM, NBA JAM Tournament Edition, and NBA Hang Time. Whether you're executing a precision buzzer-beater from downtown or soaring through the air to go "on fire," you’re in for the ultimate arcade basketball showdown.Engineered for peak performance, this Countercade features a vibrant 7-inch color LCD screen that captures every monster dunk, flashy crossover, and pixel-perfect detail with stunning clarity. You aren't just playing a port; you’re playing a faithful recreation of the arcade experience. The full-size, real-feel joysticks and buttons are ruggedly built to handle intense head-to-head action and rapid-fire button mashing. To complete the immersion, built-in dual speakers blast out the iconic, snarky commentary and sneaker-squeaking soundtracks that defined 90s gaming.The compact, space-efficient design makes this the undisputed MVP of your office desk, home bar, or gaming nook. It’s more than a game—it’s a collector’s piece. The integrated light-up marquee provides an authentic retro glow, while the officially licensed cabinet artwork ensures it looks just as good as it plays.Flexibility is at the core of the Countercade experience. Power up your way using 4 "AA" batteries (not included) for effortless gaming on the go, or use the micro-USB port for a permanent courtside seat in your home. With its built-in carrying handle and lightweight build, you can take your talents anywhere—from the breakroom to the backyard. No quarters, no lines, just pure, unadulterated basketball history.
